summary: In a fiction excerpt from Book 6, Arthur and the narrator speak with Checker, who is tracking Professor Sonya's phone and suggests bringing in the authorities such as the NSA because of a threatening note. Arthur asks for twenty-four hours before deciding whether to make the call himself. The conversation then turns to Pilar, whom the narrator has armed with a gun at her request, prompting Arthur's anger and a sharp exchange about firearm safety and hypocrisy.
one_line: Arthur and the narrator debate whether to bring in the NSA over a threatening note, then clash over the gun the narrator gave Pilar.
key_facts: Checker says he is keeping tabs on everyone and is tracking Professor Sonya's phone, and that she has been staying put.
Arthur promises he will run away if it looks like there will be any danger to the group.
Checker suggests the matter may be a job for the authorities, specifically an agency like the NSA.
Checker argues the NSA would have resources the group can only dream of and could start putting safeguards in place for the most sensitive government systems.
Checker notes the NSA would probably be as likely to recruit Professor Sonya as to throw her in a cell.
Arthur asks for twenty-four hours, saying that if they cannot contain the problem he will make the call himself.
Checker says the bad guys probably cannot make good on the note's threat yet.
Arthur says he worries about Checker and Pilar while people are trying to kill them.
The narrator reveals that they gave Pilar a gun after she begged them to teach her to shoot.
Arthur whips around in anger, having told Pilar he would teach her to shoot himself.
The narrator says Arthur should not have left the task to them and that the office manager should be armed.
Arthur says he does not want to live in a world where Pilar must carry a gun.
The narrator calls Arthur hypocritical because he holds a carry permit.
Arthur asks whether the narrator at least taught Pilar muzzle safety.

entities.name: Arthur
entities.role: Companion who is worried about Professor Sonya's safety and who leans toward running away from danger

entities.name: Checker
entities.role: Contact who tracks phones and monitors everyone, and who suggests bringing in the authorities

entities.name: Professor Sonya
entities.role: Person being protected, whose phone Checker is tracking and whose notes are the subject of the threat

entities.name: Pilar
entities.role: Office manager who is given a gun by the narrator at her request

entities.name: NSA
entities.role: Government agency that Checker suggests could help protect sensitive systems and might recruit Sonya
